key_expressions: Is it okay even if I don’t have experience?,
When can I have the interview?,
How much is the hourly pay?,

A: Hi, I saw your part-time job post and wanted to ask a few things.
Is the position still open for applicants?
Great, then I’ll start by filling out the application.
B: Hello! Yes, thanks for reaching out.
Yes, we’re still hiring, so feel free to apply.
Once you fill it out, I’ll review it right away.

A: Could you tell me what the working hours are?
Oh, afternoon hours—that actually works really well for me.
Okay, I’ll note that I’m available during those hours.
B: On weekdays, it’s from 1 p.m. to 6 p.m.
Yes, many students prefer that time slot.
Alright, you can write that on your form.

A: I don’t have much experience. Is that okay?
Oh, there’s training included!
Great, then I’ll learn quickly and do my best.
B: Yes, many beginners start with us.
A short basic training session is all you need.
As long as you’re willing to learn, you’ll adapt quickly.

A: Could you tell me the hourly pay?
Oh, that’s better than I expected.
Okay, got it about the pay!
B: The current hourly rate is 11,000 won.
Weekend shifts come with an extra 1,000 won.
Feel free to ask if you want to know more.

A: Do I have to work on weekends too?
Oh, it’s optional? That’s good to hear.
Then I’ll mention that I can work only when I’m available.
B: No, it’s not required. You can choose your weekend shifts.
Some people only work weekends, actually.
Just let us know your preferred schedule.

A: When can I have the interview?
Wow, that soon?
Alright, please book that time for me.
B: We’re available this afternoon or tomorrow morning.
Yes, our schedule is flexible, so we can arrange it quickly.
Great, I’ll record it and contact you shortly.

A: How does the job usually start out?
Yes, I think starting with simple tasks would be good.
Okay, I’ll take it step by step and get used to it.
B: At first, you’ll handle simple tasks like guiding customers or organizing items.
Once you get used to things, you can learn other tasks too.
Feel free to ask questions anytime while learning.

A: Do we get a lunch break?
Oh, flexible short breaks sound nice.
Alright, I’ll make sure to take breaks when needed.
B: The shift is short, so there’s no official lunch break.
But you can take short breaks whenever needed.
Let us know if anything feels uncomfortable.

A: What should I wear to work?
Casual is fine? That’s easy.
Okay, I’ll dress neatly and comfortably.
B: Casual clothing is totally fine.
Just make sure it looks neat.
If needed, we provide an apron.

A: Is there anything I need to prepare before my first day?
Alright, I can get those ready quickly.
Perfect, I’ll have everything prepared before I come.
B: Just bring your ID and something to write with.
We’ll provide all training materials.
Please come a little early on your first day.
